incentives.name: Sales and use tax exemption for enterprise IT equipment and software in qualified data centers
incentives.what: Exempts enterprise information technology equipment and computer software used in a qualified data center from sales and use tax; under 6-year interim committee review in 2025

dockets.what: Agassiz Transmission Line & Substation: about 1.74 miles of 345-kV line tapping the Maple River-Bison line and a new 345/34.5-kV substation just south of Harwood, Cass County; estimated cost $110 million. Reported as the power project serving Applied Digital's Harwood campus (the order itself does not name the customer). Certificate and route permit granted.
Applied Digital request for a jurisdictional determination on backup generation (filed 2026-04-24). Which campus it covers is not stated in the case listing.
Certificate of public convenience and necessity case titled 'Applied Digital 2nd Data Processing Extension' (filed 2023-10-02). Campus not confirmed from the listing (MDU serves the Ellendale area).

local_rules.what: 180-day moratorium on data centers approved in June 2026, repealed about a month later
